prompt:
Create a high fidelity desktop web application UI comp, edge to edge, crisp readable text, no browser frame or device. Product: Bakiano / Madrid Delivery Sim, an operations lab where technical reviewers inspect queue-driven delivery agents and optional Google Cloud AI decisions. Use the user's pinned reference: Linear-style dark operations console, calm, dense, graphite surfaces, a single muted teal accent for selection and routes, amber/red only for actual warning/error states. Typography pairing: IBM Plex Sans for UI and IBM Plex Mono for numbers and technical IDs. No purple, gradients, oversized titles, decorative hero, or nested cards.

This option is MAP-LED. A slim shared top navigation names Delivery, Restaurants, Inventory, Health, Traces, Architecture. Compact title 'Delivery operations' with 'Local simulation' and a 'Start simulation' action. One horizontal KPI strip: 'Orders/min', 'On-time', 'Cost / delivery', 'p95 decision'; absent evidence uses an em dash. The main working area is a large muted dark city street map, subtle buildings, restrained teal route trails, custom small courier/shop/household markers and a compact legend. Alongside it a live 'Agents' list with role and status filters, six readable rows, status pills and tiny throughput histories. Selecting 'Lucia Mora' highlights a courier and opens state, current task, last decision, 'Open trace'. Below the map starts a compact order table. Realistic illustrative data must be labeled 'Synthetic session'. Optimize for a 1440×960 laptop screen. Make the map-to-agent selection the signature interaction; everything else precise, quiet and buildable.
